exposure: Cervical dilatation at time of cesarean section
Gestational age at delivery (preterm vs. term)
outcome: Prevalence of niche formation in cesarean section scar
cohort: Women undergoing their first cesarean section for various obstetric reasons
finding: While gestational age and cervical dilatation did not affect the prevalence of niche formation, active labor and preterm delivery were associated with a lower RMT and a more cervical location of the cesarean section scar.
